Distinct attractive setting, costume and composition specific to this concept. Collection: Music and the Spotlight. Portrait: Disco Superstar. Scene and costume: sequined capelet, disco floor.

recipe.instruction: Match the original individual face exactly: muzzle length, skull, eye shape, ears, age and asymmetric markings. Keep the face naturally lit and attached to its own neck. Every visible animal surface must use the ORIGINAL dog coat distribution and texture, including forelegs, paws, hindquarters and tail. The erased template animal contributes no coat information. Use a relaxed natural canine sitting posture with the front paws under the shoulders, bent hindquarters, and proportions matching the source dog. Preserve the costume and scene.
